title: OpenUI publishes a cost-and-validity benchmark for generative interfaces
friendlyTitle: A new test compares how well AI models build app screens
summary: OpenUI's public benchmark compares 30 models on structural validity and cost, and tests OpenUI, A2UI and json-render across 1,104 generated screens per format. The published data reports a 99.9% render rate and 96.9% structural validity for OpenUI, with downloadable JSON and CSV results.
friendlySummary: OpenUI tested many AI models and three screen formats. It measured whether the screens were built correctly, whether they appeared at all and how much generation cost.
whyItMatters: Teams building interfaces generated at runtime need to measure valid structure, blank renders, repair rates and cost rather than judging screenshots alone. The downloadable results provide a starting point for choosing a model and format, though vendor-run benchmarks should be reproduced on each product's own screens.
friendlyWhyItMatters: App teams can use the data to choose a model and format. They should also repeat the test with their own designs because the benchmark comes from one of the format makers.
